visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a four-way splitscreen montage. The top-left quadrant shows a bright hotel room with a white-linen bed and a black suitcase. The top-right shows a man in a striped shirt walking away down a brightly lit, carpeted hallway. The bottom-left displays a laundry room with stacked silver dryer and washer units. The bottom-right shows a clean bathroom with a glass shower door and white sink. (2) A close-up shot of an airport flight information board displays white text on purple and blue backgrounds in English and Thai, indicating transfer desks and gates. The camera pans smoothly across the sign. (3) An exterior shot of a tall, modern grey building is seen against a cloudy, overcast sky. The camera looks upwards, emphasizing the height and the repetitive grid of square windows. (4) A man wearing a black and blue striped shirt and denim shorts stands outside next to a large red and white sign for 'NISHITETSU HOTEL CROOM'. He points at the sign with a smile, then is seen walking under a black umbrella near a busy urban street with traffic and overhead railway tracks. (5) A hand holds an orange and white checkered keycard up to a digital door lock. A green light flashes on the reader, and the man opens the dark brown door to reveal a well-lit hotel room interior. (6) A sequence of screen captures showing text-heavy online reviews appears on screen. Red and blue circle icons with the characters for 'full' and 'negative' are overlaid to highlight positive and negative sentiment. (7) The man peeks his head out from a sliding wooden door inside the room, smiling at the camera. The room tour begins, showing a low wooden desk, a flat-screen TV on the wall, and an orange fabric sofa next to a wooden side table. The lighting is warm and soft. (8) A wide shot shows the interior of the bathroom featuring a walk-in shower with a glass partition, a white countertop with a square sink, and a large mirror. Promotional images of other room types, including one with two beds and one with a large bathtub, appear as picture-in-picture inserts. (9) The man walks down a hotel hallway again, this time waving his arms excitedly and looking back at the camera. He wears a black crossbody bag. (10) A close-up of a framed promotional poster shows a bowl of fried chicken with the text 'CHICKEN KARAAGE' and 'ONLY 200'. (11) The video shows the hotel lobby area with a reception desk, a wooden bench, and a vending machine filled with various snacks and bottled drinks. The man points at the vending machine. (12) The final shot is an exterior view of the hotel building from the street level. A blue text box appears on the left side providing the hotel's name, address, and social media handle in Chinese and English.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively acoustic-pop background music track begins immediately, featuring a bright acoustic guitar rhythm at 118 BPM. A male narrator introduces the video in an energetic, high-pitched, and enthusiastic tone. (2) The narrator's speech becomes faster and more excited as he describes the Japanese brand's expansion into Bangkok. The BGM remains consistent with a steady, driving drum beat. (3) A subtle digital 'beep' and a mechanical door latch click are heard as the narrator mentions checking into the hotel. His voice drops slightly in volume to convey a sense of 'insider info' about reviews. (4) The narrator lists various online complaints in a rapid, rhythmic delivery, maintaining high clarity and an engaging tone. The BGM continues unchanged, providing a cheerful foundation. (5) As the room tour begins, the narrator's voice rises in pitch and excitement, emphasizing positive findings. Short digital 'ding' sounds accent the appearance of text on screen. (6) The narrator discusses specific room features like the orange sofa and wide luggage rack with a warm, conversational tone. The BGM volume stays balanced under the speech. (7) An excited vocal inflection occurs as the narrator discovers the large sink and bathroom amenities. His speech is continuous with very few pauses. (8) The video concludes with the narrator expressing high satisfaction. The BGM maintains its tempo until a quick fade out at the very end of the clip.
